foundry_checklist.name: Design Rule Checking (DRC)
foundry_checklist.specification: 0 violations across 1,008 rules (width, spacing, enclosure, density)

foundry_checklist.name: Layout-Versus-Schematic (LVS)
foundry_checklist.specification: 0 discrepancies across devices, nets, and I/O ports

foundry_checklist.name: Electrical Rule Checking (ERC / Antenna)
foundry_checklist.specification: Antenna ratio <= 250:1 on all transistor gate oxide connections

foundry_checklist.name: Post-Layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX)
foundry_checklist.specification: Full SPEF netlist extraction; crossbar settling t_settle <= 5.0 ns

foundry_checklist.name: Multi-Corner Static Timing Analysis (STA)
foundry_checklist.specification: WNS >= 0.0 ps, TNS = 0.0 ps across TT/SS/FF corners (-40C to 125C)
foundry_checklist.actual_value: WNS = 0.0 ps, TNS = 0.0 ps, CDC MTBF > 1.45e9 yr

foundry_checklist.name: Dynamic Power Grid & SSN Noise
foundry_checklist.specification: f_res > 2.5 GHz; dynamic voltage noise <= 50.0 mV (<= 5% VDD)
foundry_checklist.actual_value: f_res = 3.66 GHz, Total Delta V = 12.51 mV (1.25% VDD)

foundry_checklist.name: Electromigration Reliability (Black's Rule)
foundry_checklist.specification: J <= 1.50 mA/um at 105C; projected lifetime >= 10.0 years

foundry_checklist.name: ESD Clamp Protection
foundry_checklist.specification: > 2.0 kV HBM and > 500 V CDM protection on all external I/O pads
foundry_checklist.actual_value: 2.2 kV HBM / 650 V CDM via dual-diode + ggNMOS clamps

foundry_checklist.name: GDSII Reticle Alignment & Guard Seal Ring
foundry_checklist.specification: 100 um perimeter stress seal ring; valid GDSII/OASIS checksum
foundry_checklist.actual_value: 100 um seal ring integrated, GDSII SHA-256 validated
